Bug_Details: Instant APIs only work for NANOS, MICROS, MILLIS, SECONDS, MINUTES, HOURS, HALF_DAYS and DAYS.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is caused by using an unsupported TemporalUnit (ChronoUnit.WEEKS) with Instant.plus(). Instant only supports NANOS, MICROS, MILLIS, SECONDS, MINUTES, HOURS, HALF_DAYS, and DAYS.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case triggers the bug by calling the showBug() method, which attempts to add a week to the current Instant using an unsupported TemporalUnit, ChronoUnit.WEEKS. This operation is invalid and causes an exception.
